test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If class A has 11 boys and 18 girls, class B has 13 boys and 17 girls, and class C has 20 boys and 9 girls, which class has the biggest ratio(s) of boys to girls?

options.text: Both class A and class B

solution:
**Given:**

Class A: 11 boys, 18 girls

Class B: 13 boys, 17 girls

Class C: 20 boys, 9 girls

**Formula used:**

Ratio = Number of boys / Number of girls

**Calculation:**

Class A Ratio = 11 / 18

⇒ Class A Ratio = 0.611

Class B Ratio = 13 / 17

⇒ Class B Ratio = 0.765

Class C Ratio = 20 / 9

⇒ Class C Ratio = 2.222

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
